parts.products: oil products (HS 2710) plus other fossil products in HS 27 (coke, petcoke, bitumen, electricity; of_which_other_fossil_in_products in gross_customs)
parts.pipeline_gas: natural gas by pipeline (HS 271121; European transit countries by country of final use)
parts.other: everything else bought from Russia (fertiliser, metals, grain, gold passed on by hubs...): the site's total minus the five fuels, so the parts add up exactly
parts.total_site: the site's 'Paid to Russia' value (to_rus.years in site/data.json): FOB at the Russian border, after the build's reassignments (see method)
parts.gross_customs: what the importer's customs record, CIF, before the site's reassignments: the figure to quote for 'X's imports of Russian crude' (prices.json windfall_parts paid)
parts.tracker_crea: CREA fossil fuel tracker for the same destination and year (Kpler-based shipments x CREA prices, FOB-like, destination = first discharge or pipeline border): an independent cross-check
parts.memo_russian_crude_in_fuel_bought_from_t: the site's separate 'laundered oil' line (Russian crude inside fuel bought from India, Türkiye, China...): not part of total_site

method: Start: importers' customs by fuel (prices.json windfall_parts 'paid'; Eurostat Comext for the EU, UN Comtrade otherwise; Türkiye's hidden crude+gas value split in proportion to EPDK gas volume x gas_prices.json price and CREA tracked crude). Countries outside prices.json: CREA tracker fuel, remainder other.

Customs layer to site: the build's value at its first traced step (gas by final use, partner and non-reporter corrections, the floor at tracked fuel value) above the customs parts goes on 'other'; below them, every part is scaled down with the customs mix kept; where the floor at tracked fuel lifted the value, that lift goes on the fuels in CREA's mix.

Each later build step is put on the part it concerns (refiners' exported crude -> crude; hubs' gold and goods -> other; UAE fuel -> products; freight -> each part by its own CIF->FOB factor, scaled to the step's total); steps with no fuel meaning are spread in proportion.

Ranges: the site's own band for the total, combined with a split error by basis (customs A 3%, B 8%, C 15%; tracker 20%; Türkiye's hidden crude and gas 25%) and 25% of the modelled reassignments that hit a part; 'other' carries the fuel errors since it is the remainder. Low and high are not additive across parts.
